content:
OpenAI has previewed more than 20 announcements for its DevDay 2026 event. The event will be live-streamed. Here's everything announced today.

OpenAI Event Livestream

We expect the main release to be ChatGPT's response to SpaceXAI's Grok Bot and Meta's Muse, adding broader consumer market appeal on top of its existing AI agent tools.

OpenAI already has a similar feature under its ChatGPT Work framework, but the experience isn't as straightforward as Muse and Grok Bot.

In any case, you can tune in to the livestream right on time. The event begins at 10:00 a.m. PT (1:00 p.m. ET).

Dots, an AI agent that runs around the clock

First up: dots. These are AI agents that run around the clock, a brand-new feature in ChatGPT.

ChatGPT Space

Next is a new feature called ChatGPT Space. It's a collaborative workspace where you can work with dots, manage pages and presentations, and handle live documents.

GPT-6.1 Sol

OpenAI has also announced the release of its new GPT-6.1 Sol model.

OpenAI said: "We're rolling out GPT‑6.1 Sol, an upgrade to GPT‑6 Sol that matches GPT‑6 Astra's intelligence on agentic coding, computer use, and professional work, but at one-fifth the price per million standard input and output tokens as Astra."

"Cached input is priced at $0.10 per million tokens — 95% less than standard input pricing and 50% less than GPT‑6 Sol's cached input pricing, giving developers more room to build and run efficient agents that reuse context across requests."

You can read more about the new model here.

All the new announcements

The event is still rolling on, and OpenAI's website already has a full summary of everything announced today, including the new $500-per-month subscription plan and more, so be sure to check it out.
